paper_title: Axion and neutrino bounds improved with new calibrations of the tip of the red-giant branch using geometric distance determinations
notes: Stellar cooling bound on axion-electron coupling g_ae from TRGB brightness. Best bounds: g_ae < 1.6e-13 (NGC 4258), g_ae < 1.3e-13 (omega Centauri) at 95% CL; 68% CL bounds g_ae < 0.79e-13 (NGC 4258), 0.64e-13 (omega Cen). These are single upper-limit values, not a function of mass (axion is essentially massless/light in this bremsstrahlung process). No mass-dependent exclusion curve provided, so data_points left empty. The relevant numbers: g_ae(95%CL) = 1.6e-13 NGC4258, 1.58e-13 LMC(F20), 1.25e-13 LMC(Y19), 1.29e-13 omega Cen (from Table I, g13 values).
